description: Keyword search over ClearMind Capital's published Q&A answers and Clarity Corner articles on retirement, Social Security, taxes (including Ohio and Columbus), investing, estate planning and trusts, 401(k) and workplace retirement plans, cash balance plans, and working with a fee-only advisor. Returns the best matches, each with the published answer text and its source URL, or an empty list with browse links when nothing matches. No auth; general education only, never advice for a specific person. Use for a specific money question. To browse the library by date or topic use list_clarity_corner; for facts and fees about the firm use get_firm_overview.

limit.description: Most results to return (1-10, default 5). Weak matches are dropped, so you may get fewer.

query.description: The question or topic in plain words, e.g. 'Roth conversion before retirement'. Full questions work; no operators or quotes needed.

name: search_answers
title: Search ClearMind Capital's published answers
